units.source_text: 是日戌时，源氏来到西殿。

en.t: That day, at the hour of the Dog, Genji came to the west wing.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后所居西厅旁边一室，已布置成着裳仪式会场。

en.t: A room beside the west hall where Empress Akikonomu lived had already been arranged as the venue for the robe ceremony.

units.source_text: 替女公子梳发的内侍等也都来了。

en.t: The palace attendants who were to comb the young lady's hair had all arrived as well.

units.source_text: 紫夫人乘此机会与秋好皇后相见。

en.t: Lady Murasaki took this opportunity to meet Empress Akikonomu.

units.source_text: 两家侍女云集一处，人数异常众多。

en.t: The women attendants of both households gathered in one place, and their number was extraordinarily large.
At the hour of the Rat, the robe ceremony was held.

units.source_text: 灯光虽然朦胧，秋好皇后看见女公子容貌十分秀美。

en.t: Although the lamplight was dim, Empress Akikonomu could see that the young lady was exceptionally beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏向皇后道谢：“辱承不弃，敢以陋质进见，请为结腰。

en.t: Genji thanked the Empress, saying, "You have graciously not rejected us; I humbly present this unworthy child and ask you to tie her waist cord.

units.source_text: 深恐后世之人，将以此为先例也。

en.t: I deeply fear that people in later generations may take this as a precedent.
With the deepest awe and humility, I respectfully offer my thanks."

units.source_text: 皇后答道：“愚陋无知之人，遵嘱勉为成礼。

en.t: The Empress replied, "One as foolish and ignorant as I merely followed your request and did my best to complete the ceremony.

units.source_text: 乃蒙过分夸奖，反觉不安于心。”

en.t: To receive such excessive praise only makes me feel uneasy."

units.source_text: 她如此逊谢，态度异常生动而娇艳。

en.t: As she answered with such modest thanks, her manner was extraordinarily lively and charming.

units.source_text: 源氏看见这许多才貌双全的美人集中于一家，觉得幸福无疆。

en.t: Seeing so many women of both talent and beauty gathered in one household, Genji felt boundless happiness.

units.source_text: 只是小女公子的生母明石夫人未得参与盛会而正在悲叹，实为一大憾事。

en.t: Only the young lady's birth mother, Lady Akashi, was lamenting that she could not take part in the splendid gathering, which was truly a great regret.

units.source_text: 源氏颇思派人前去邀她出席，但恐别人诽议，终于作罢。

en.t: Genji very much considered sending someone to invite her, but fearing others' criticism, he finally gave up the idea.

units.source_text: 六条院中所举办的仪式，即使寻常之事，也极隆重豪华，何况此次盛会。

en.t: Ceremonies held at the Rokujo estate were extremely solemn and luxurious even when they were ordinary occasions, so all the more so was this grand event.

units.source_text: 倘照通例缕述，而只能写出其一端，则反而乏味，故不详叙。

en.t: If one were to describe it in detail as usual yet could record only a small part of it, the account would instead become dull, so it will not be narrated at length.
